budget_origin: Pre-run initial exposure v2: 262144 joint steps rounded up to whole rollout; not convergence or success criterion
selection_basis: All native actions categorical. Per-role native returns; no assumed shared team reward. Parameter sharing with explicit role index permits different role policies and bounds memory at up to 768 roles. Local observations only, no privileged critic.
memory_limit: Four local frames, feedforward; partial observation can require recurrent follow-up, not claimed sufficient.

task.objective: Cultivate and ship two fruits from each of twelve household stores while maintaining local pollinator and soil conditions.
task.natural_termination: Terminate when each household has actually shipped two fruit units; otherwise truncate at t=768. Bees are ecology entities, not controllable agents or individual agent-done rows.
task.interaction: Gates and built hedges alter physical bee corridors; apiary relocation changes their flight interval and carrying suspends flight. Sluice diversion removes downstream water after one tick. Pollinators carry disease between flowering plots. Three markets each allocate one shipping slot among four competing household queues every four ticks.
task.observation_access: Local 7x7 terrain, growth stage and occupancies; self tools/stocks; up to four detailed neighbors, two plots, one apiary and four bees. Detailed entity masks are narrowed to exactly the available records. Water/store/gate state is local; coarse messages travel Manhattan 6. Public season is in each self row.

native_event_definitions.meaning: Actor pruned or composted a plot
Actor lifted or placed an apiary
Flowering plot became fruiting this tick
Pollinator was struck by a newly closed gate or built hedge
Store shipped one fruit using its shared-row market slot

primary_metric: mean across roles of unmodified native episode returns; inspect role vector and task events, mean can cancel in competitive games
evaluation_policy: stochastic legal-action sampling; same independent seeds and native horizon for random/IPPO
selection_rule: No selection by evaluation; initial final checkpoint reported, every intermediate point retained
stop_rule: Complete frozen joint-step exposure. Stop safely for nonfinite values, native contract error, resource limit, or explicit coordinator/user instruction. Wall slices resume same identity.
scope: Existing Crucibles games only; does not implement original LLM/UED/meta-gradient experiment
